format: Yocto BitBake/BBL (shell and python scripts combined)
description: This file contains BitBake configuration snippets, functions in Python, and shell commands to generate and configure syslog-ng configuration files during the build process. It manages syslog-ng setup including metadata creation, filter, destination, and log configurations based on device properties and features.

methods.name: generate_syslog_ng_config
methods.description: Main Python function invoked during build to create syslog-ng configuration artifacts.

methods.name: create_metadata_file
methods.description: Creates combined filter and metadata configuration files for syslog-ng based on device properties.

methods.name: update_constants
methods.description: Updates and generates the main syslog-ng configuration file with global options, templates, and version info.

methods.name: update_filters
methods.description: Reads device-specific filters from metadata and updates syslog-ng configuration with filter rules.

methods.name: update_destination
methods.description: Configures syslog-ng destinations based on metadata, including fallback destination.

methods.name: update_log
methods.description: Defines log statements in syslog-ng config, including handling for sslendpoints and log rates.

methods.name: clear_tmp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary filter and metadata directories used during build.

methods.name: update_properties
methods.description: Appends device properties indicating syslog-ng enablement.
